name: Oatmeal with Cherries, Nutmeg & Honey Yogurt
instructions: Place water and salt in a medium saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once boiling, stir in oats, honey, and nutmeg. Cover and let simmer on low until oats reach desired consistency, 3-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place yogurt and additional honey in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
Place cherries in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Roughly chop.
When the oatmeal is done, add cherries to the pan and stir to combine. Continue to cook until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide oatmeal between bowls and top with honey yogurt. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
